parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The default value is the current time.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the DSW instance.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return on each page. The value cannot be greater than 1440.

parameters.name: MetricName
parameters.description: The name of the metric. For more information, see [Metric Names](https://cms.console.aliyun.com/metric-meta/acs_pai_dsw/dsw).

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The Cloud Monitor namespace where the metrics are stored.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The default value is one hour before the current time.
